concept: Growth of Political Ideas and Political Organisations upto 1885
question: Who founded the Bombay Presidency Association in 1885 along with Pherozeshah Mehta and KT Telang?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Badruddin Tyabji**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Badruddin Tyabji** was one of the founders of the Bombay Presidency Association in 1885.
 
• He was a prominent lawyer and politician in India during the British rule.
 
• Tyabji, along with Pherozeshah Mehta and KT Telang, established the association to address the issues and concerns of the people in the Bombay Presidency.
 
• The Bombay Presidency Association played a significant role in the Indian freedom movement by voicing the demands of the Indian populace to the British authorities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Badruddin Tyabji** was also the first Indian to practice as a barrister of the High Court of Bombay.
 
• He served as the third President of the Indian National Congress in 1887.
 
• Tyabji was a strong advocate for social reforms, especially in the areas of women's education and rights.
 
• His efforts contributed significantly to the socio-political awakening in India during the late 19th century.
